"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Worker centers in the Guangdong Province of China have played a significant role in assisting internal migrant workers to fight for wages.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Worker centers in the Guangdong Province of China have played a significant role in assisting internal migrant workers to fight for social benefits to which they are legally entitled.",

"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Panyu Center assisted forty local sanitation workers sign new contracts with the new contractor.",
